lines.english: The night of December 31.

lines.japanese: 新年を間近に控えた大都市柳木原は、こたつとミカンとバラエティ番組で年越しを迎えたくないひとびとが大挙し、いつにも増して眠らない街の様相を呈していた。
lines.english: With the new year just around the corner, the metropolis of Yanagihara had drawn great crowds of people who did not wish to greet it with a kotatsu, mandarin oranges, and variety shows. More than ever, it had become a city that never slept.

lines.japanese: 一大ターミナルの駅舎から吐きだされたひとの群れは、それぞれバーやらクラブやらカラオケやらへと散らばってゆく。
lines.english: The tide of humanity poured out of the station, a major transportation hub, and scattered into bars, clubs, karaoke parlors, and elsewhere.

lines.japanese: しかしもっとも大きい勢力は、繁華街の向こう、美空神社へと向かう参拝客たちだ。
lines.english: But the largest contingent consisted of worshipers bound for Misora Shrine on the far side of the entertainment district.

lines.japanese: そしてその雑踏の中に、我ら美空学園三年Ａ組・羽田班四名も含まれていた。
lines.english: And among that throng were the four members of the Haneda group from Class 3-A at Misora Academy.

lines.japanese: 「すげえ人ごみだなァ。どいつもこいつも初詣初詣って、年の瀬だってのに他に行くとこないのかねェ」
lines.english: “Hell of a crowd. First shrine visit, first shrine visit—doesn't anybody have somewhere else to be on New Year's Eve?”

lines.japanese: 「ははは！　年の瀬だから行くんだろぉ、こーいつぅ！」
lines.english: “Ha-ha-ha! They're going *because* it's New Year's Eve, you rascal!”

lines.japanese: いかにもツッコミ待ちな愚痴を吐いた針生蔵人に、俺はジャンピング裏拳をお見舞いしてあげた。
lines.english: Kuroudo Hariu had voiced a complaint begging for a retort, so I treated him to a jumping backfist.

lines.japanese: 「ほーんと、歩きにくいよね。ぱね田くんさー、ちょっといつもの奇行でこの辺ササッと人払いしてよ」
lines.english: “It really is hard to walk. Hey, Paneda, do one of your usual freak acts and clear everybody out of the area.”

lines.japanese: 「ははは！　俺は露出狂のストリーキングじゃないぞぉ、こーいつぅ！」
lines.english: “Ha-ha-ha! I'm no exhibitionist streaking through the streets, you rascal!”

lines.japanese: いかにも反論待ちな注文をつけた渡来明日香に、俺はフライング肘鉄をお見舞いしてあげた。
lines.english: Asuka Watarai had made a request begging for an objection, so I treated her to a flying elbow.

lines.japanese: 「みんな信じてない神様にすがるほど切迫してるんだね。ん、違うか……慣習という名の惰性に安寧を見いだしたいのかな。うん、イイね、日本人って感じする」
lines.english: “They must be desperate if they're turning to gods they don't believe in. No, wait... Maybe they want to find comfort in the inertia we call tradition. Yeah. Nice. Very Japanese.”

lines.japanese: 「ははは！　何がイイんだか意味が分からないぞぉ、こーいつぅ！」
lines.english: “Ha-ha-ha! I have no idea what part of that is nice, you rascal!”

lines.japanese: いかにも聞き返し待ちな感想を述べた山科京に、俺はランニング頭突きをお見舞いしてあげた。
lines.english: Miyako Yamashina had offered an observation begging for a question, so I treated her to a running headbutt.

lines.japanese: 「いやあ、しかし今年は何をお願いしようかなあ！　あっ、そうだ、お願いが百個かなうお願いをお願いしよう！　うひょおー、これぞお願い錬金術～、羽田君アッタマい～い！」
lines.english: “Still, what should I wish for this year? Oh, I know! I'll wish for a wish that grants a hundred wishes! Woo-hoo! Wish alchemy! Haneda, you genius!”

lines.japanese: そして俺は、いかにも無視する気まんまんだった三人めがけ、ダイビング・ワイルドベビー・サイクロン（オリジナル必殺技）をお見舞いしてあげた。
lines.english: Then I aimed at the three people who were plainly determined to ignore me and treated them to a Diving Wild Baby Cyclone. (My original finishing move.)

lines.japanese: 「痛い。ぱね田、落ちつけ」
lines.english: “Ow. Settle down, Paneda.”

lines.japanese: 「ははは！　おまえは落ちつき過ぎだぞう渡来！　みんな仲良く初詣だなんて、うきうきしちゃって溢れる情熱が抑えきれないだろう！」
lines.english: “Ha-ha-ha! You're too settled down, Watarai! We're all going to the first shrine visit together! How can you contain the excitement and overflowing passion?!”

lines.japanese: 「さあ駆けだすぞ、友らよ。奈落の名に懸けて、我が旗へ続くのだ。そうれ全軍、前へーッ！」
lines.english: “Now run, my friends! In the name of the abyss, rally to my banner! All forces, forward!”

lines.japanese: 「渡来さん、お正月は実家帰るの？」
lines.english: “Watarai, are you going home for New Year's?”

lines.japanese: 「んー、どーしよ。山科ん家でおせちでも食べてよっかなあ」
lines.english: “Hmm, what should I do? Maybe I'll eat New Year's food at Yamashina's place.”

lines.japanese: 「俺いま昆虫料理にハマッてんだよ。カマドウマ差し入れしてやろうか」
lines.english: “I'm really into insect cuisine right now. Want me to bring you some cave crickets?”

lines.japanese: 「おいおい、どうしたおまえたち、もうバテたのかあ？　しっかり付いてこいよ！　新年～！　ファイ、オー！　ファイ、オー！　ファイ、オー！　新年～……」
lines.english: “Come on, what's wrong with you people? Tired already? Keep up! New Year! Hup, two! Hup, two! Hup, two! New Year...!”

lines.japanese: こうして羽田班のひとびとは、いつまでも仲良く平和に暮らしましたとさ。
lines.english: And so the members of the Haneda group remained the best of friends and lived happily ever after.

lines.japanese: めでたしめでたし。
lines.english: The end.
